lxc_fb79fcb58e212073.text: LINE grew from a simple text messenger into a platform for communication and daily services.

lxc_894ba141646bd6c4.text: Its value is strong in some places, but “the best app” depends on a person’s needs, location, and concerns.

lxc_20bc49cf0e5da752.text: People may call LINE the best because it connects them with the people and services around them.

lxc_d4d34c6aa282adf8.text: To understand why many people call it the best app, first look at how network effects work.

lxc_be9400235eb6810d.text: This is called a **network effect**: an app becomes more useful when more people in your community use it.

lxc_a3b7a5b0f18e9344.text: If your family, friends, workplace, and local organizations are all on LINE, you may need only one main communication app.

lxc_7b370e51ab9f01d3.text: The effect is especially strong in some Asian markets.

lxc_54258c01f5f81cae.text: On March 31, 2026, LY Corporation reported 193 million monthly active LINE users worldwide.

lxc_f050d664ece4252d.text: This included 100 million in Japan, 54 million in Thailand, and 22 million in Taiwan.

lxc_bf109066986f55d3.text: These numbers show LINE’s regional strength, but they also suggest that it is not equally central everywhere.

lxc_34871ca944b3d024.text: LINE began because of a serious communication problem.

lxc_22edb3ab78880753.text: After the Great East Japan Earthquake, many people had difficulty contacting family and friends by telephone and email.

lxc_d09d71c319810ae6.text: LINE launched in Japan on June 23, 2011.

lxc_483f13100b073bad.text: Its first version could send text messages only.

lxc_02a69b16f1cc82f5.text: The app quickly added more ways to communicate.

lxc_984151635f4ffeea.text: Free calls and emoji and stickers arrived in October 2011 and helped LINE grow rapidly.

lxc_7e9dc05318392a5b.text: Then LINE moved beyond personal messages.

lxc_b9ff96eb2ded6a8e.text: LINE Official Account launched in May 2012, LINE GAME followed in November, and LINE NEWS started in July 2013.

lxc_8a694a29f221ae26.text: A **platform** connects communication with other activities, content, and services.

lxc_85f72d3798a5e9de.text: This change is an important reason for LINE’s strong position.

lxc_92f2ca2b6b3d9b84.text: The history of the LINE app is not exactly the same as the history of the company behind it.

lxc_262a6e0511097050.text: In April 2013, NHN Japan changed its name to LINE Corporation.

lxc_4bd045d02f5513e5.text: As the business grew, LINE Corporation listed its shares in both New York and Tokyo in July 2016.

lxc_1b87ba62f9dc5b92.text: A larger change happened on October 1, 2023.

lxc_ee3f74c57ca7b6e1.text: Z Holdings, LINE Corporation, Yahoo Japan Corporation, Z Entertainment, and Z Data completed a group reorganization.

lxc_c8734a53f29da995.text: Together, they began operating as LY Corporation.

lxc_a5d53e49251970c9.text: The main app still kept the familiar LINE name.

lxc_859aaa4a592f5814.text: This difference matters: a product can keep its name and identity while its company structure changes.

lxc_c9a01e065dacea80.text: The new company brought the LINE and Yahoo Japan businesses together under one organization.

lxc_d1ad967c0d483225.text: LINE has offered services connected with content, shopping, business, finance, and other parts of daily life.

lxc_efa9b0bf5d2eed47.text: LY Corporation also says that LINE now has emergency features and that local governments and other organizations use it as a disaster-response tool.

lxc_b0a249946bf34389.text: For users in these communities, LINE can connect private conversations with useful public information.

lxc_557f9e2fe56309e9.text: However, a large platform does not provide the same services forever or in every country.

lxc_110d0f8f59c097cc.text: LINE Pay began in Japan in December 2014, but it ended there on April 30, 2025.

lxc_743e9b3ce195d5f6.text: Payment functions were reorganized around PayPay.

lxc_9c0f487c9efd8230.text: The closure did not include LINE Pay in Taiwan or Thailand.

lxc_b870986678b24671.text: This example shows both the strength and weakness of a broad platform: it can offer many connected services, but those services can change or disappear.

lxc_5714b92a16970f4d.text: The argument for LINE is clear.

lxc_ffdf88bb9d7ca674.text: It combines communication with other useful services, and its large regional networks make it part of everyday life for many people.

lxc_eed94453067bd4c1.text: Its history of growth also shows how it expanded from a simple messenger into a platform combining communication, content, commerce, and other everyday services.

lxc_a6ff94f25c77f813.text: There are also reasons to be careful.

lxc_2ee4669a6dabc44e.text: In 2023, LY Corporation reported unauthorized access and confirmed or possible leakage of user-related personal data.

lxc_5138a758f0e7f192.text: It said that bank details, credit-card numbers, and LINE chat conversations were not included.

lxc_4f28b2a88b7a1363.text: The company also says LINE uses several encryption technologies and publishes reports about them.

lxc_eb23a314516a1138.text: These protections matter, but no large online service can remove every security or data risk.

lxc_d9714513351fc4f6.text: In addition, LINE’s regional concentration means it cannot be the most useful app for everyone.

lxc_11b9b402b4de3330.text: “Best” is therefore a personal and local judgment, not a universal fact.
